rows.question: Who reaches the most?

2. Christian Graham — 34 reaches / 56 ADP-joined picks (61%)
3. Randy Broner Jr — 31 reaches / 59 ADP-joined picks (53%)
4. LOZELL STYLES — 31 reaches / 55 ADP-joined picks (56%)
5. Marlon Moore — 30 reaches / 46 ADP-joined picks (65%)
